modelOverview: Launched in 2007, the Ballon Bleu de Cartier reimagined the Maison's watchmaking with a rounded, balloon-like case and a signature protected crown set with a blue synthetic spinel. The 36mm size sits as the mid/unisex proportion of the line, offered here in steel on a steel bracelet with a silvered guilloché dial.

WSBB0048.movement: Automatic · Cartier Calibre 1853 MC (Sellita-based) · ~37h power reserve
WSBB0048.materials: Stainless steel case and stainless steel interchangeable bracelet
WSBB0048.dial: Silvered guilloché dial with Roman numerals, blued sword-shaped hands, no date window
WSBB0048.description: The WSBB0048 is the steel-on-steel Ballon Bleu 36mm, pairing a silvered guilloché dial with blued sword-shaped hands and Cartier's signature fluted crown set with a synthetic spinel cabochon. Its rounded, softly curved case and interchangeable steel bracelet make it a versatile everyday Cartier icon. Every piece we offer is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.

W4BB0036.movement: Automatic · mechanical movement with automatic winding
W4BB0036.materials: Stainless steel case and interchangeable steel bracelet; sapphire crystal
W4BB0036.bezel: Steel bezel set with 54 brilliant-cut diamonds (0.78ct)
W4BB0036.dial: Silvered sunray-brushed dial set with 21 brilliant-cut diamonds (0.19ct), Roman numeral XII and blued-steel sword-shaped hands; fluted steel crown set with a synthetic cabochon-shaped spinel
W4BB0036.description: Note: reference W4BB0036 is an all-steel Ballon Bleu rather than a steel-and-gold model. In the 36mm case it sets 54 brilliant-cut diamonds around the bezel and 21 more as hour markers on a silvered sunray dial, driven by a self-winding movement and worn on the interchangeable steel bracelet. Every piece we offer is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.
